s: Two people sitting side by side on a couch, turned toward each other: a woman in her fifties with dark brown skin and short grey natural hair listens with her head tilted, chin resting on her hand, blinking slowly, lips still; a man in his fifties with olive skin and salt-and-pepper hair speaks slowly with one open hand in front of him, eyebrows lifted at their outer ends, mouth softening at the end of his sentence

A woman in her sixties with olive skin, glasses and grey hair in a bun sits in a consulting room listening to someone off-frame, pen resting on the desk, head tilted, her eyes warm and steady, the outer corners of her eyes crinkling faintly, one hand open on the desk in a welcoming gesture

A man in his forties with deep brown skin and short curly hair passing a woman in her forties with light tan skin and black wavy hair on the landing of an apartment stairwell, his hand landing warm and calm on her shoulder as he goes by. Her eyes close for a second, her face softens, her shoulder lifts slightly to meet his hand; his mouth curves, his jaw unclenched

A man in his forties with warm brown skin and short curly hair and a woman in her forties with pale freckled skin and auburn waves still seated at either end of a dining table after a meal, plates pushed aside. Each looks off in a different direction; he holds a cold cup with both hands, her palm lies flat on the tablecloth. Both faces show the same quiet bewilderment: brows knitted, lips slightly parted, tired eyes, shoulders sunk

A young adult man with warm brown skin and short curly dark hair lying awake on his side at night, a phone glowing faintly in his hand. His eyes are wide open and bright, a helpless grin he cannot control, shoulders hunched with restless energy, the duvet twisted around him. Single character in frame

A man with pale lined skin and thick white wavy hair setting a cup of coffee in front of a seated woman with soft white curls and warm brown skin at a kitchen table, unasked. She looks up at him with crinkled eyes and a small private smile; his eyebrows are soft, his mouth relaxed, one hand still on the saucer. They are clearly in their seventies: deep smile lines around the eyes, loose skin at the neck, spotted hands

A woman in her twenties with medium brown skin and long dark curly hair sitting on the floor of a small student room, holding a phone against her chest with both hands. Her eyes are very wide, eyebrows high, breath held, an uncontrollable smile breaking across her face, knees drawn up. Single character in frame

A man in his thirties with pale freckled skin and auburn waves sitting in a train seat beside his partner, a woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and short curly hair, asleep with her head on his shoulder. He holds a book in one hand, the other resting lightly on her arm; his face is entirely unguarded, shoulders low, a faint contented curve to his mouth. Only the two of them in frame

A man with deep brown skin and short grey curly hair adjusting his partner’s scarf at the front door before she leaves; she has light tan skin and greying dark waves. She tilts her chin up to let him do it, eyes half closed; both wear tiny amused smiles, his hands careful and unhurried at her collar. He is clearly in his fifties: deep lines at the corners of the eyes, greying temples, loose skin at the jaw

A woman in her forties with light olive skin and dark wavy hair and a man in his forties with medium brown skin and short greying curls standing on a small balcony at dusk, close together but each facing a different way. She looks out over the railing, eyebrows pulled together, mouth tense; he watches her sideways with worried searching eyes, one shoulder raised, a hand half lifted and unsure where to land

A woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and long dark curls and a man in his twenties with pale skin and chestnut waves meeting in a bedroom doorway in the morning, stopping to look at each other before either speaks. Eyes meeting and holding, eyebrows lifted, small genuine smiles, bodies turned toward one another

A man in his fifties with light tan skin and greying dark waves resting one hand flat on the back of his partner, a woman in her fifties with warm brown skin and short curly hair, on the pavement outside a building before she walks off. Her chin turns back toward him, eyes warm and crinkled; his eyebrows are soft, his mouth calm, his hand unhurried

A woman in her thirties with medium brown skin and dark curly hair leaning forward across a small table toward a man in his thirties with pale freckled skin and auburn waves, chin propped on one hand, asking him something. Her eyebrows are raised in real curiosity, her eyes steady on him; he looks up, surprised, eyebrows lifting, mouth opening slightly

A man in his forties with deep brown skin and short curly hair sitting with a laptop on his knees, lifting his eyes from the screen as his partner, a woman in her forties with light olive skin and dark wavy hair, comes through the door. His face opens toward her, eyebrows rising, a small welcoming smile; she stops, shoulders dropping, surprised and pleased

A woman in her thirties with deep brown skin and short curly hair at a desk, a colleague, a man in his forties with pale skin and chestnut waves, leaning in to praise her work. She ducks her chin, eyes cast down, an awkward half-smile pulling at one side of her mouth, one hand raised to wave the compliment away. Only the two of them in frame, the rest of the room suggested with a single blurred chair

A man with pale skin and thick grey wavy hair sitting in an armchair with a small wrapped gift on his lap. His eyebrows are raised high, mouth slightly open, eyes flicking toward the giver off-camera, one hand already drifting toward his jacket pocket, visibly flustered. He is clearly in his sixties: deep lines around the eyes and mouth, loose skin at the neck, spotted hands. Single character in frame

A woman in her forties with light olive skin and dark wavy hair sitting across a café table from a friend, a man in his forties with deep brown skin and short curly hair, both hands wrapped around a warm cup. Her chest is open, shoulders low, eyes crinkled at the corners, a slow unhurried smile as she listens, steam rising between them. Only the two of them in frame

A man in his thirties with warm brown skin and short curly hair sitting alone at a small desk at night, thumb hovering over a banking app on his phone, working out what he owes. His eyebrows are drawn together, lips pressed, his other hand rubbing the back of his neck, shoulders heavy, a lamp the only light. Single character in frame

A man in his twenties with light olive skin and dark wavy hair at a bistro table, already pulling out his phone to send his share back, thumb on the screen, eyes down, shoulders turned slightly away, while a woman in her twenties with deep brown skin and long dark curls across from him is still mid-sentence, one hand open in the air, her smile beginning to falter. Only the two of them in frame

A woman in her fifties with medium brown skin and dark curly hair at the corner of a kitchen table across from her grown son, a man in his twenties with medium brown skin and short curly hair, no one else in frame. Both her hands rest still on the tablecloth and she looks directly at him, eyes warm and slightly wet, eyebrows relaxed, an unguarded small smile, shoulders dropped, chin level

A woman in her twenties with pale freckled skin and auburn curls standing in a small bathroom, fingertips resting at the base of her throat. Her brows are knitted, her eyes lowered and inward-looking, her mouth slightly open as if she has just noticed something in her own body. Single character in frame
